description: The service categories vendors on Mediawork offer, such as Editorial, Sound Post or Visual Effects. Each has a uuid — pass it as `service` to search_facilities to filter the directory to vendors offering that service. Call this first when a question is about a kind of work.

locale.description: Two-letter language code (en, fr, es, pt, it, de, nl, pl, th, hi, ko, ja). Defaults to English.
